summary: Frontend-only visual redesign of /shop verified end-to-end. Single-row Zepto-style header, big flex search, Zepto-style category tiles, floating ADD stepper on product images, and green price badge with strike MRP + '₹X OFF' chip all render correctly on desktop and mobile. Add-to-cart no longer navigates, cart badge updates, category filter and search filter still work.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.js is 454 lines with multiple sub-components (HeroBanner, SubPill, ProductCard, ProductCardMobile, GridSkeleton) and 20-entry CAT_THEMES table inline. Consider extracting sub-components to /components/consumer/ for maintainability (approaching the 500-line soft cap).
Both ProductCard (desktop) and ProductCardMobile share ~90% code but differ only in sizing tokens. Consider merging into a single component with a `size` prop to remove duplication.
test_credentials: Guest browsing only; sign-in path not exercised (spec allows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. Key testids working: city-btn, mobile-city-btn, search-input, nav-login (guest), nav-cart (with .bg-[#22C55E] badge span when items>0), cat-top-all, cat-top-<name>, clear-filters-top, product-card-<id>, add-cart-<id>, qty-inc-<id>, qty-dec-<id>. Note: ProductCard renders in BOTH desktop and mobile blocks (one hidden via lg:hidden/hidden lg:block), so `product-card-<id>` yields 2 elements per product; use `:visible` filter or scope by container in future scripts.
verified_flows: Header layout single-row (h=73px) with logo, city-btn, search-input (flex-1), nav-login, nav-cart
Section header = 'Shop by category' for guest
10 category tiles rendered (All Items + 9 categories) with themed gradients and emojis
ADD click added item to cart, cart badge showed '1', URL stayed on /shop (no navigation)
ADD button transformed into qty-inc/qty-dec stepper
Clicking 'Atta & Rice' tile activated filter and showed clear-filters-top
Search 'dal' returned 3 filtered visible product cards with correct results
Mobile viewport: mobile-city-btn visible, desktop city-btn hidden, nav-login hidden, nav-cart visible
